entities.summary: Bob Smalhout was a Dutch physician, professor and author. Smalhout, an anesthesiologist, worked at the Utrecht Academic Hospital and the Utrecht University. Smalhout was the Lijsttrekker for the Pim Fortuyn List (LPF) party for the Dutch Senate election of 2003. Smalhout was the son of Elias Smalhout and came from a Reform Judaism family.
